sources.summary: KAAN Architecten has completed Matchbox, a compact timber mixed-use building in Eindhoven's Strijp-S district. Designed as a calm landmark within the former Philips industrial site, the project offers a sustainable alternative to conventional concrete construction. Built almost entirely from timber, Matchbox combines offices, social rental housing, and shared outdoor spaces within a clear modular design.
